items.title: Ford’s Sales and Revenue Are Down. The Automaker Isn’t Sweating It
items.summary: Ford Motor’s  revenue fell in the second quarter amid declining U.S. sales.  The automaker is nonetheless upbeat about the auto industry.  The Dearborn, Mich., company on Tuesday raised its full-year profit forecast and said it is confident Americans would continue to buy pricey, big pickups and sport-utility vehicles that dominate its lineup.

items.title: F Stock Jumps 8% After-Hours On Q2 Earnings Beat — Ford Also Raises 2026 Profit Outlook
items.summary: Ford topped Wall Street's Q2 revenue and adjusted EPS estimates, while adjusted EBIT rose year over year.

items.title: Ford (NYSE:F) Misses Q2 CY2026 Revenue Estimates, But Stock Soars 6.6%
items.summary: Automotive manufacturer Ford (NYSE:F) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales falling 3.8% year on year to $48.3 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.42 per share was 21.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Ford Motor Company (F) Beats Q2 Earnings Estimates
items.summary: Ford Motor (F) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +27.27% and -1.81%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
